metadata.title: Clinical Practice Guideline: Management of Hypertension in Adults

recommendations.title: Blood Pressure Target — General Adults
recommendations.content: For most adults with hypertension, aim for a target blood pressure of < 140/90 mmHg. Intensification of therapy is recommended when blood pressure remains at or above this threshold on repeat measurement.

recommendations.title: Pharmacological Therapy — ACE Inhibitor Titration
recommendations.content: When blood pressure remains above target on a stable dose, titrate lisinopril upward to reach the blood pressure target, up to the maximum tolerated dose. Reassess blood pressure and renal function 2-4 weeks after each dose increase.

recommendations.title: Lifestyle — Dietary Sodium and Balanced Diet
recommendations.content: Adopt a balanced diet rich in vegetables, fruits, whole grains, and lean proteins while limiting sodium, refined carbohydrates, and added sugars. Dietary counseling by a registered dietitian is recommended to support blood pressure control.
